cohort: 38,927 individuals who gave birth, including 883 with a reported NSAID allergy/adverse drug reaction
finding: Individuals with reported NSAID allergies/adverse drug reactions had higher postpartum opioid utilization, both during hospitalization and at discharge, compared to those without reported NSAID allergies, regardless of mode of delivery.
mod_finding: The association between reported NSAID allergy and opioid use was observed for both vaginal and cesarean deliveries.
